text.p: Germany's Gunda Niemann came close to breaking speed skating's oldest world record in leading a German sweep of the women's 1,500 metres at the world speed skating championships on Saturday.
Niemann clocked two minutes 0.51 seconds, the second-fastest 1,500 metres ever recorded. Anni Friesinger was second in 2:02.00 ahead of Claudia Pechstein who placed third in 2:02.52.
All three were wearing the new "clap" skates, which release at the heel, allowing skaters a more natural stride.
East German Karin Kania-Enke, the only woman ever to break two minutes for 1,500 metres, set her record of 1:59.30 in 1986 at Almaty in Kazakhstan.
